title: Person: Screen view
description: A mobile "screenview" event attributed to a person. Our `screen` and `page` event types are more specific than our standard `event`, and help you track and target people based on the pages people visit in your mobile app or website.

action.description: A mobile "screenview" event attributed to a person. Our `screen` and `page` event types are more specific than our standard `event`, and help you track and target people based on the pages people visit in your mobile app or website.

id.description: A valid ULID used to deduplicate events. Note - our Python and Ruby libraries do not pass this id.

name.description: The name of the screen a person visited. This is how you'll find and select screen view events in Customer.io.

timestamp.description: The Unix timestamp when the event happened.

attributes.description: Additional information that you might want to reference in a message using liquid or use to set attributes on the identified person.

additionalProperties.description: Insert key-values that you want to reference in your message here.

cio_id.description: A unique identifier set by Customer.io, used to reference a person if you want to update their identifiers.

not_nullable_customer_id.description: The ID of a customer profile, analogous to a "person" in the UI.

not_nullable_email_address.description: The email address of the customer.

type.description: The operation modifies a person in Customer.io

identifiers.description: The person you want to perform an action for—one of `id`, `email`, `phone`, or `cio_id`. You cannot pass multiple identifiers. You can use `email` and `phone` only if they're enabled as identifiers in your [workspace settings](/accounts/workspaces/overview/#migrate-workspace).

phone.description: A person's phone number, in [E.164 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164) (a leading `+` followed by up to 15 digits). Available only when `phone` is enabled as an identifier in your workspace.
